compute_radical_inverse: compute the radical inverse of an integer n in a given base for low-discrepancy sampling
generate_halton_sequence: generate a Halton sequence point for a given dimension and index using prime bases
generate_hammersley_sequence: generate a Hammersley sequence point combining uniform sampling with Halton sequence values
sample_sphere_hammersley: sample uniformly distributed points on a sphere using the Hammersley sequence with optional offset and remapping
review_random_utils: review the random_utils module and its low-discrepancy sequence functions for quasi-random sampling
